entries.text: Wellll, isn't it obvious?
entries.raw_text: Wellll, isn't it obvious?

entries.speaker: ELAINE
entries.text: Uh! Ah, is Noreen there?
entries.raw_text: Uh! Ah, is Noreen there?

entries.speaker: KRAMER
entries.text: Yes, she is..
entries.raw_text: Yes, she is..

entries.speaker: ELAINE
entries.text: Well? Can I talk to her?
entries.raw_text: Well? Can I talk to her?

entries.speaker: KRAMER
entries.text: What? Am I, tooo.. boring for you?
entries.raw_text: What? Am I, tooo.. boring for you?

entries.speaker: ELAINE
entries.text: [tired] Fine--would you just put her on?
entries.raw_text: [tired] Fine--would you just put her on?

entries.speaker: KRAMER
entries.text: Well, I feel it'd be best if you just didn't talk to her for a while..
entries.raw_text: Well, I feel it'd be best if you just didn't talk to her for a while..

entries.speaker: ELAINE
entries.text: You feel?
entries.raw_text: You feel?

entries.speaker: KRAMER
entries.text: That's right! She an' I have had a very long talk. An' I was appalled to learn of the destructive influence you've had over her life lo these many years..
entries.raw_text: That's right! She an' I have had a very long talk. An' I was appalled to learn of the destructive influence you've had over her life lo these many years..

entries.speaker: ELAINE
entries.text: What are you insane?!
entries.raw_text: What are you insane?!

entries.speaker: KRAMER
entries.text: From now, on, I'll be calling the shots around here..
entries.raw_text: From now, on, I'll be calling the shots around here..

entries.speaker: ELAINE
entries.text: Oh! Haha. An' what're you gonna tell her?
entries.raw_text: Oh! Haha. An' what're you gonna tell her?

entries.speaker: KRAMER
entries.text: Well. I've encouraged her to go back into the Army.. There she'll get the structure an' the discipline she needs right now.. And she'll have qualified officers telling her what to do..
entries.raw_text: Well. I've encouraged her to go back into the Army.. There she'll get the structure an' the discipline she needs right now.. And she'll have qualified officers telling her what to do..

entries.speaker: ELAINE
entries.text: Uh! Kramer! You have got to let me talk to her!
entries.raw_text: Uh! Kramer! You have got to let me talk to her!

entries.speaker: KRAMER
entries.text: Can't help ya, kid. [Back at the Costanzas'. Still daylight.]
entries.raw_text: Can't help ya, kid. [Back at the Costanzas'. Still daylight.]

entries.speaker: ESTELLE
entries.text: You're not Chinese!?!?
entries.raw_text: You're not Chinese!?!?

entries.speaker: DONNA
entries.text: [pause] No.
entries.raw_text: [pause] No.

entries.speaker: ESTELLE
entries.text: I thought you were Chinese!!
entries.raw_text: I thought you were Chinese!!

entries.speaker: DONNA
entries.text: I'm from Long Island.
entries.raw_text: I'm from Long Island.

entries.speaker: ESTELLE
entries.text: Long Island?!?! I thought I was gettin' advice from a Chinese woman!!
entries.raw_text: Long Island?!?! I thought I was gettin' advice from a Chinese woman!!

entries.speaker: DONNA
entries.text: I'm sorry..?
entries.raw_text: I'm sorry..?

entries.speaker: ESTELLE
entries.text: Well! Then, that changes everything!
entries.raw_text: Well! Then, that changes everything!

entries.speaker: GEORGE
entries.text: What?!
entries.raw_text: What?!

entries.speaker: ESTELLE
entries.text: She's not Chinese; I was duped!!
entries.raw_text: She's not Chinese; I was duped!!

entries.speaker: GEORGE
entries.text: So what?! She gave you advice; what's the difference if she's not Chi nese?!?!
entries.raw_text: So what?! She gave you advice; what's the difference if she's not Chi nese?!?!

entries.speaker: ESTELLE
entries.text: I'm not taking advice from some girl from Long Island!! [goes into KITCHEN]
entries.raw_text: I'm not taking advice from some girl from Long Island!! [goes into KITCHEN]

entries.speaker: GEORGE
entries.text: [chases her] Wait a minute! You're--now you're getting a divorce because she's from Long Island?!?!
entries.raw_text: [chases her] Wait a minute! You're--now you're getting a divorce because she's from Long Island?!?!

entries.speaker: FRANK
entries.text: [from the living room, standing, shouts after them] You want a divorce?!!? You got one!!!
entries.raw_text: [from the living room, standing, shouts after them] You want a divorce?!!? You got one!!!

entries.speaker: JERRY
entries.text: [pause, to DONNA] You know, you might wanna think about changin' your name.. [Day. JERRY and ELAINE, walking down the street.]
entries.raw_text: [pause, to DONNA] You know, you might wanna think about changin' your name.. [Day. JERRY and ELAINE, walking down the street.]

entries.speaker: ELAINE
entries.text: So, ever since she started dating Kramer, she won't even talk to me!
entries.raw_text: So, ever since she started dating Kramer, she won't even talk to me!

entries.speaker: JERRY
entries.text: Well--Noreen listened to you like George's mother listened to the Chinese.
entries.raw_text: Well--Noreen listened to you like George's mother listened to the Chinese.

entries.speaker: ELAINE
entries.text: [pause] You know, everybody listens to the Chinese. I mean, look at the fortune cookie. You couldn't get away with that in any other restaurant.
entries.raw_text: [pause] You know, everybody listens to the Chinese. I mean, look at the fortune cookie. You couldn't get away with that in any other restaurant.

entries.speaker: JERRY
entries.text: [has just bought a newspaper out of a machine] Yeah, no one's reading any rolled-up messages in a knish.. [A cab pulls up and GEORGE gets out.]
entries.raw_text: [has just bought a newspaper out of a machine] Yeah, no one's reading any rolled-up messages in a knish.. [A cab pulls up and GEORGE gets out.]

entries.speaker: GEORGE
entries.text: Oh, it had to happen!! I knew it!!
entries.raw_text: Oh, it had to happen!! I knew it!!

entries.speaker: JERRY
entries.text: Hey.
entries.raw_text: Hey.

entries.speaker: GEORGE
entries.text: I predicted it! [hits cab roof twice, it drives off] Saw both of them today! What a disaster! I'm runnin' all over Queens. First I saw my mother. We had lunch together. Never had, Lunch, with my mother before--it's like a date! Then we drive down to Kew Gardens! Tons of traffic! I see my father. We played "Clue"! All day with this! [KRAMER sticks his head out of his (or Jerry's) apartment window, shouts down to them.]

entries.speaker: KRAMER
entries.text: Hey, Jerry! Guess what! The Kramer name might live on! Noreen's late! She's laaate!! [During credit roll. Night on the Brooklyn Bridge. NOREEN peers over the edge, the wind blowing up on her face. Then a man in a black cape edges over to her cautiously, reaches and holds her forearm.]
